      Overview

      AI-Tuned Visual Clarity

      Utilising Vision AI, the SAMSUNG 65-inch 4K QLED TV automatically adjusts visuals and sound based on real-time scene analysis. As a result, whether it's a fast-paced thriller or a calming landscape film, the viewing is always optimised for clarity and immersion.


      Precision Light Management

      Featuring Quantum Matrix technology, this TV delivers controlled illumination for improved contrast and enhanced detail. This ensures vibrant colours, sharp highlights, and defined shadows, even in varied lighting conditions.


      Adaptive AI Performance

      Backed by the NQ4 AI Gen2 processor, this smart TV refines picture and sound dynamically depending on the content being played. This leads to smooth transitions, clear dialogue, and consistently high-quality visuals.


      Upgraded Resolution Output

      With AI-powered 4K Upscaling, this QLED TV enhances old or low-resolution videos into near-4K definition. So, legacy content is given new life with added clarity and detail for a more engaging watch.


      Intelligent User Personalisation

      Learning from your viewing habits, AI Customisation mode of this TV fine-tunes settings for a personalised experience. So, whether you're a sports enthusiast or a drama lover, this TV adapts to your preferences.


      Colour Fidelity

      Thanks to Pantone Validation, this 4K TV ensures accurate and consistent colour reproduction. So, every visual, from skin tones to scenic vistas, appears authentic and vibrant.


      Cinematic Contrast Enhancement

      Increasing the contrast and brightness spectrum, Neo Quantum HDR of this TV reveals subtle details in both highlights and dark areas. This delivers a rich, lifelike picture that's ideal for film enthusiasts.


      Synchronised Surround Sound

      With Q-Symphony, audio is harmonised between this 65-inch TV and compatible SAMSUNG soundbars without deactivating the TV speakers. This delivers full and layered sound for a deeply immersive listening experience.


      Central Smart Home Control

      Featuring built-in IoT, this TV serves as a hub for compatible smart home devices. This provides effortless control over your lighting, appliances, and other connected tech, all from your TV.


      Multi-Assistant Support

      With compatibility for several voice assistants like Alexa and Bixby, this TV allows voice-based navigation and control. You can adjust settings, access apps, or operate smart devices.


      Split-Screen Viewing

      Through Multi View, this SAMSUNG TV displays two streams side-by-side, such as a series and a mirrored phone screen. This helps you stay connected while catching up on entertainment simultaneously.


      Instant Entertainment Access

      Offering a broad collection of free live channels and on-demand content, SAMSUNG TV Plus removes the need for subscriptions. Thus, you can just power up and dive into a variety of shows, movies, and more.


      Comprehensive Data Protection

      Providing robust, multi-layered security, SAMSUNG Knox ensures your personal data and smart integrations remain safe while using this TV’s features online or offline.
